main.description: Returns one organization result for each supplied actor DID, preserving input order and duplicates. Authentication is not required. actors is a required nonempty array of 1..100 DIDs, counted before deduplication and encoded as repeated unbracketed query keys. Handles are not resolved; the query uses indexed records only and makes no network calls. A missing organization sidecar is returned as null, and present sidecars include the associated profile or null. This endpoint does not paginate.

actors.description: Actor DIDs to look up; repeated unbracketed values preserve their original order and duplicates.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: actors must contain 1 through 100 valid DIDs; unknown query parameters are not accepted.

errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed organization sidecars or associated profiles could not be queried.

organizations.description: One result per supplied actor occurrence, in input order. The organization is null when no indexed sidecar exists.

actor.description: Actor DID from the corresponding request occurrence.

organization.description: Hydrated actor view when this DID has an indexed organization sidecar; otherwise null.
